question: Find the value of [ (84 div 6) times left{ (91)/(7) + (16)/(2) times (8 - 6) right} ]
solution:
**Given:**

Find the value of [ (84 ÷ 6) × { (91 ÷ 7) + (16 ÷ 2) × (8 - 6) } ]

**Formula used:**

Perform operations inside brackets first, then solve from innermost to outermost brackets.

**Calculations:**

⇒ [ (84 ÷ 6) × { (91 ÷ 7) + (16 ÷ 2) × (8 - 6) } ]

⇒ [ (84 ÷ 6) × { 13 + 8 × 2 } ]

⇒ [ 14 × { 13 + 16 } ]

⇒ [ 14 × 29 ]

⇒ 406

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
